summary: Tasklio iteration 3 (frontend-only, offline Expo web preview, viewport 390x844) — all 4 requested changes verified end-to-end plus regression. (1) Wallet: 'Recent activity'/'Payout history' tabs (wallet-tab-activity/wallet-tab-payouts) render and switch; activity list capped at exactly 10 rows (seeded 11 txns via admin credits); 'View all' (wallet-view-all-activity) appears ONLY when txns>10 (verified hidden with 1 and 3 txns, visible with 11) and navigates to /recent-activity showing all 11 rows. (2) No '+0' history: played Quiz Time answering all 5 questions wrong (deterministic via known BANK answers) → 0 pts awarded, txns count unchanged (11→11), zero-point txn count = 0, no '+0' text in wallet. (3) Rejected payout refund: requested ₹1 payout (100 pts, test@bank) → balance 0; admin set status failed via admin-status-{id}-failed → points refunded to 100, newest txn = 'Payout rejected · refund for test@bank' (+100, kind=payout) rendered at top of wallet Recent activity, plus 'Withdrawal rejected' notification created. (4) Home header compact: menu x=16 w=36, greeting 'Hii, Test User' fully visible (x=62, w=212), points badge x=274 h=32, bell right-aligned x=338 — no extra gaps; drawer compact with all 6 rows + Restricted Area card visible and close button working. Regression: create-account flow, 14-tile games grid, payout request flow all pass.

issues: Refund entries use kind='payout' so they render the 'bank-transfer-out' icon (an outflow glyph) even though the refund is money coming IN (+100). Cosmetic only — icon color is correctly green. Consider a distinct icon (e.g. bank-transfer-in / cash-refund) for refund txns.
Long UPI in refund title is truncated with ellipsis ('refund for t...') due to numberOfLines={1} — acceptable, full text visible nowhere; consider showing full title on /recent-activity.

critical_code_review_comments: app-store.tsx earnPoints (line 212): txns entry skipped when points === 0 — matches requirement; verified at runtime via 0-point quiz outcome.

app-store.tsx setPayoutStatus (lines 258-298): on 'failed' refunds Math.round(amountRupees * POINTS_PER_RUPEE) AND prepends a +refund txn titled 'Payout rejected · refund for {upi}' — verified end-to-end including balance restoration and notification.
wallet.tsx line 36: recent = state.txns.slice(0, 10) and line 174: view-all gated on state.txns.length > 10 — both verified UI-side (1, 3 and 11 txn cases).

Note: setPayoutStatus refunds even if the same payout is set to 'failed' twice (admin could double-refund by toggling failed→pending→failed). Edge case not in scope but worth a guard (skip refund if payout.status was already 'failed').
home.tsx header uses compact fixed-height icon slots (36x40) with greeting flex:1 marginLeft:10 — bbox measurements confirm tight, edge-aligned layout.
drawer-menu.tsx: compact 48px avatar, 12px row padding, 20px icons; all rows have correct testIDs and are tappable.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 6 feature/regression groups verified end-to-end with UI + state assertions)

seed_data_creation: Two throwaway accounts created in ephemeral browser contexts (Test User/9876543210 with 11 admin-credit txns; Refund Tester/9876543211 with a failed+refunded payout). No persistent seed data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: localStorage 'tasklio_state_v3' value is DOUBLE-ENCODED JSON on web (JSON.parse twice). Fresh automation sessions do not preserve localStorage — clear + create account each session. Quiz deterministic-0 trick: BANK questions/answers are hardcoded in /app/frontend/app/games/quiz.tsx (lines 15-22); click option (answer+1)%4 five times via quiz-option-{0..3} for a guaranteed 0-point outcome. Payout id for admin status pills: read payouts[0].id from localStorage state, then admin-status-{id}-{pending|successful|failed}. /restricted → PIN 1234 → admin. Viewport 390x844.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found this iteration. Prior '+0' history bug root cause (earnPoints unconditionally prepending a txn) is fixed via points !== 0 guard; prior missing refund-entry bug is fixed by prepending a +refund txn inside setPayoutStatus. Both fixes confirmed working at runtime.
